# Heart Mind Talent
> Specialist recruiters for foundational tech teams (AI and tech startups). Est. 2023. London.

Heart Mind Talent hire foundational tech and AI teams for startups: first engineers, technical leads, CTOs, PMs, Research Scientists and FDEs.
